verdict.rationale: Bridge's orchestration docs say the platform programmatically supports off-ramps, which is a first-party off-ramp capability. However, nothing in the pack describes stablecoin-to-bank-transfer rails or a published list of currencies and countries. Stripe's own stablecoin payouts deliver USDC to wallets rather than local fiat, and community reports say recipients must convert through third parties. Missing for 10: documented stablecoin-to-bank-transfer rail details, a published list of supported fiat currencies and countries, recipient-side fiat landing flow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, recipients can land in local fiat — documented off-ramp rails that convert stablecoins into bank transfers across a published set of currencies and countries

citations.quote: Programmatically support on-ramps, off-ramps, and crypto-to-crypto flows.
Send payouts to third parties in more than 160 countries worldwide.
